reasoning: This is a fork of Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), a multi-component ML pipeline orchestration service. It includes a Go backend with an API server, driver, launcher, persistence agent, scheduled workflow manager, and cache server (each with its own Dockerfile). It also provides a React frontend web UI, a Python SDK for authoring pipelines, reusable pipeline components, and Kustomize manifests for Kubernetes deployment. The project is a service platform — not an operator (it doesn't define CRD controllers or reconciliation loops), not a library (it runs as a standalone deployed system), and not pure configuration. It exposes REST/gRPC APIs, persists state in MySQL, orchestrates workflows via Argo Workflows, and serves a web dashboard.
